reviews.text: Took my E90 335i here after the dealer quoted me $3,200 for the oil filter housing and a coolant leak. Import Haus did it for half that with the same OEM gaskets, and Stefan walked me through the whole job. Been my only shop since.
reviews.author: Marcus T.

reviews.text: I've got a 997 Carrera and I don't let just anyone near it. These guys did the IMS evaluation, a full suspension refresh and a pre-track check. They drive these cars, they get it. The dealer never explained anything this clearly.
reviews.author: Priya N.

reviews.text: My B8 A4 had an intermittent misfire two other shops couldn't sort. Import Haus found a cracked coil boot and a carbon issue in one visit, fixed it right, and didn't throw parts at it hoping something stuck. Genuinely knowledgeable.
reviews.author: Greg L.
